Genomic heritability of egg weight in Gallus gallus: a GBLUP study

Wei Li1, Jane A. Smith1,2
1College of Animal Science, Example University, Beijing, China
© The Author(s) 2025

Open Access This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

PMCID: PMC11000001 PMID: 40000001

Abstract

Background

Egg weight (EW) is a key trait with heritability h2 reported between 0.4 and 0.6.

Results

Using 12,000 SNPs we estimated h2 = 0.45.

Conclusions

Genomic selection for EW is feasible.

Keywords: GBLUP, Egg weight, Heritability

Introduction

Egg weight has been studied extensively [1, 2]. Earlier work used pedigree BLUP [3].
